name: boolean_negation
description: Python NOT of a single Boolean literal with worked examples; matched control evaluates bool of the same literal.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(80):
 vals=[bool(random.getrandbits(1)) for _ in range(4)];a=bool(i%2)
 pre='Evaluate each Python expression.\n'+''.join(f'not {v} = {not v}\n' for v in vals)
 con='Evaluate each Python expression.\n'+''.join(f'bool({v}) = {v}\n' for v in vals)
 items.append({'prompt':pre+f'not {a} =','answer':' '+str(not a)})
 control.append({'prompt':con+f'bool({a}) =','answer':' '+str(a)})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
